name: Open Browser workspace
description: Idempotently reveals the embedded Browser workspace for the current conversation and reuses or creates its local Browser session without navigating.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 幂等展开当前会话的工作台并切换到内嵌浏览器，复用或创建该会话的本地 Browser Session；不发起网络导航。
localizedDescription.en-US: Idempotently reveals the embedded Browser workspace for the current conversation and reuses or creates its local Browser session without navigating.

focus.description: Focus the Browser workspace after opening. Defaults to true.
